model: Fender Player II Modified Active Jazz Bass V - Olympic Pearl, Maple Fingerboard
description: 5-string Electric Bass Guitar with Alder Body, Maple Neck, Maple Fingerboard, and 2 Single-coil Pickups - Olympic Pearl
product_info: Equally current and timeless, the Player II Modified Jazz Bass V beautifully blends the J Bass's storied heritage with modern flair in the form of quality tonewoods, high-performance hardware, and reimagined electronics. Featuring a classic construction, the Player II Modified Jazz Bass V offers contemporary comforts Sweetwater's Fender loyalists cannot do without, such as the modern C-shaped maple neck with smooth rolled edges that pairs with the maple fingerboard to deliver clear, articulate tone. To enhance and amplify that tone, Fender has introduced an all-new preamp with a refined 3-band EQ optimized for sonic transparency and an Active/Passive functionality that offers players ultimate flexibility when shaping their sound. Likewise, the Player II Modified J Bass V sports a set of newly voiced Noiseless pickups that serve as the bedrock for versatile Jazz Bass growl. Alongside these upgrades, Fender added some touches it knew the discerning player would appreciate — namely, a 1.875-inch TUSQ nut, tapered shaft tuners, and a HiMass bridge for enhanced intonation, sustain, and stability. For over half a century, the J Bass has masterfully held down the low end on countless records and performances — the captivating Player II Modified Jazz Bass V assuredly carries that legacy forward.

model: Fodera Ryan Martinie 'Blondie' Standard 5-string Bass Guitar - Natural Maple
description: 5-string Electric Bass, Signature, with Korina Body, Maple Top, Maple Neck, Ebony Fingerboard, and 2 Single-coil Pickups - Natural Maple
product_info: One of metal’s most beloved bassists, Ryan Martinie has inspired generations of new players with his inventive techniques and imaginative style. Most known for his work with Mudvayne, Martinie has also worked with Soften The Glare and Korn. Now, Fodera and Martinie have joined forces to produce a bass worthy of its namesake: the Fodera 5-string Ryan Martinie 'Blondie' Standard. This bass features a shortened Monarch body style made from korina with curly maple, with an eye-grabbing zig-zag top. You’ll also have access to dual slant-mounted EMG J/J5 pickups that pump out tones ripe for metal, jazz, and everything in between. Ready to plug in? The Fodera 5-string Ryan Martinie 'Blondie' Standard is waiting for you here at Sweetwater.

model: Ibanez Standard SR375E Fretless 5-string Bass Guitar - Brown Burst
description: 5-string Fretless Electric Bass with Maple Body, Maple/Rosewood Neck, Jatoba Fretboard, and 2 Humbucking Pickups
product_info: Pick up the Ibanez SR375E fretless electric bass, and you'll quickly discover that Ibanez didn't sacrifice quality to bring you a such a value-packed bass guitar. In fact, the experience of playing the SR305E is much like that of Ibanez's higher-end SR Series models, thanks to the SR375E's sleek 5-piece maple/rosewood neck and comfortable maple arched body. A pair of Ibanez PowerSpan humbucking pickups pack a phenomenal punch, while a 3-band EQ with Power Tap creates a vast array of sound-shaping possibilities. When budding bass players are looking for a quality instrument, many Sweetwater Sales Engineers place the Ibanez SR375E electric bass at the top of their list.

model: Sadowsky MetroExpress Hybrid P/J 5-string Bass Guitar - Solid Silver Metallic
description: 5-string Electric Bass with Okoume Body, Roasted Maple Neck, Roasted Maple Fingerboard, and 2 Single-coil Pickups - Solid Silver Metallic
product_info: Sadowsky’s MetroExpress 21-fret Hybrid P/J Bass seamlessly blends classic aesthetics with contemporary functionality and exceptional playability. Crafted with an okoume body, renowned for its lightweight and resonant qualities, this bass provides a rich tonal foundation. The roasted maple neck fortifies stability and strength while offering a smooth, comfortable playing experience, while the 21-fret roasted maple fingerboard adds a touch of snap and presence to the overall sound profile. Each MetroExpress Bass is equipped with Sadowsky’s signature enhancements, including advanced 2-band active electronics that allow for precise tonal adjustments, catering to a wide range of musical styles. The adjustable Just-A-Nut ensures optimal string height and intonation, improving playability. Additionally, the quick string release bridge facilitates effortless string changes, making maintenance a breeze. The noiseless P-and-J-style pickups deliver a clean, dynamic sound with excellent clarity, further enhancing tonal versatility. It all equates to a Sadowsky bass that is not only visually striking, but also a powerhouse of performance.

model: Warwick Pro Series Thumb BO 5-string Bass
description: 5-string Electric Bass with Ovangkol Body and Neck, Wenge Fingerboard, 2 Active J-style Stacked-coil Pickups, and 2-band EQ/Preamp - Burgundy Red Transparent Satin
product_info: Launched in 1985, the Warwick Thumb Bass found instant popularity cross-genre, thanks to a savvy design that accommodates all playing styles. Today, the Pro Series Thumb Bass BO still leads the pack of boutique-style electric basses it helped inspire. From the svelte curves of its sleek, compact, and exceedingly comfortable ovangkol body to its fast, “C”-profile bolt-on neck and precision fretwork to its tight, responsive low B string, the Thumb Bass BO 5-string feels incredible to play whether you’re plucking, picking, or slapping. Its active MEC pickups and 2-band EQ/preamp deliver a massive sound and versatile tonality that you can quickly sculpt to perfectly complement any music setting. Quality crafted by master luthiers in Germany, the Warwick Thumb Bass 5 is a high-performance thoroughbred. Take your playing to the next level with your Warwick Thumb Bass from Sweetwater!

description: 5-string Electric Bass with Mahogany Body, 5-piece Maple/Mahogany Neck, Rosewood Fingerboard, Active Electronics, and 2 Humbucking Pickups - Brick Burst
product_info: The Yamaha TRBX505 5-string bass guitar brings versatility, killer looks, and amazing performance together in a complete package. Factor in the Yamaha TRBX505’s solid hardware and thoughtful design, and you’ve got a great-looking bass that’s ready to rock any stage or studio session.
